CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANANDA SEN ----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Sachin Kumar, Advocate Mr. Ravi Prakash Mishra, Advocate Ms. Surabhi,
Advocate

For the Respondents : A.C. to S.C. II ----
7/ 12.10.2019 Vide order dated 22.07.2019, State was directed to file an affidavit stating as to what steps they have taken for constituting the Tribunal in terms of Section 70 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Section 70(3) and the proviso thereto prescribes that the Presiding Officer of the Tribunal shall be a person, who has been a District Judge.

The State, in their supplementary counter affidavit, at paragraphs 8 and 9, have categorically given a statement that they have written a letter to the Registrar General of this Court and also had given a reminder seeking approval.
It has been mentioned that the matter will be placed before the Cabinet only after approval is received from the High Court of Jharkhand at Ranchi.

sentences.text: Counsel for the State submits that till date they are waiting for the said approval.
Statutory Tribunals cannot be kept vacant for years.
Steps should be taken to constitute the Tribunal and make them functional.
Right to appeal has been given to the aggrieved persons under the statute.

opennyai_summary.decision:
